content:
**1) LAYOUT**
*   **Window Bounds:** 1024x768 (Maximized).
*   **Title Bar (0, 0 - 1024, 45):** Contains App Icon/Title (Left), Action Buttons (Right).
*   **Toolbar Cluster (0, 45 - 1024, 110):**
    *   Navigation Group: Home icon, Back/Forward arrows, Up arrow, Breadcrumb ("Windows (C:)").
    *   View Controls Group: List view toggle, Filter button.
    *   Search Group: Search input field with magnifying glass icon.
    *   Top-Right Actions: "Buy Now" badge, Settings icon, Hamburger menu, Window controls (Min, Max, Close).
*   **Filter Bar Row (0, 110 - 1024, 160):** "Show", "File Type", "Date Modified", "File Size" dropdowns. Right side: Toggle switch and "AI Recommend" label/link + Trash icon.
*   **Main Content Area (0, 160 - 1024, 855):** Split into three vertical panes.
    *   **Tree Pane (Left):** (0, 190 - 270, 855). Contains "Path"/"Type" tabs and a hierarchical list.
    *   **File List Pane (Center):** (270, 160 - 800, 855). Contains Column Headers (Name, Date Modified, Type) and a scrollable list of items.
    *   **Preview/Details Pane (Right):** (800, 160 - 1024, 855). Shows file preview (icon/name), metadata, and an "Open" button.
*   **Status Bar / Contextual CTA (0, 855 - 1024, 940):** Full-width banner. Left: Status message with checkmark icon. Right: Primary action button ("Recover All ...").
*   **Windows Taskbar (Bottom):** (0, 940 - 1024, 768). Standard Windows 11 taskbar.

**2) TEXT (Verbatim)**
*   **Title Bar:** `EaseUS Data Recovery Wizard Free`
*   **Toolbar:** `Buy Now`, `Windows (C:)`, `Filter`, `Search files or folders`
*   **Filter Bar:** `Show`, `File Type`, `Date Modified`, `File Size`, `AI Recommend`
*   **Tabs:** `Path`, `Type`
*   **Column Headers:** `Name`, `Date Modified`, `Type`
*   **Tree Items:** `Windows (C:)` (`1.1M`), `File Path Lost` (`4.3K`), `Reconstructed` (`87`)
*   **List Items:**
    *   `actionarchivecache` | `10/7/2026 11:30 PM` | `File folder`
    *   `actions-runner` | `10/17/2026 7:34 PM` | `File folder`
    *   `azureCli` | `10/8/2026 1:50 AM` | `File folder`
    *   `cobertura-2.1.1` | `2/26/2015 11:23 PM` | `File folder`
    *   `ghcup` | `10/8/2026 12:32 AM` | `File folder`
    *   `hostedtoolcache` | `10/7/2026 11:25 PM` | `File folder`
    *   `image` | `10/7/2026 9:08 PM` | `File folder`
    *   `inetpub` | `10/7/2026 10:10 PM` | `File folder`
    *   `Julia` | `10/7/2026 11:21 PM` | `File folder`
    *   `mingw32` | `2/19/2026 12:59 PM` | `File folder`
*   **Preview Pane:** `actionarchivecache`, `Open`, `Size`, `284 MB`, `Date Modified`, `10/7/2026 11:30 PM`, `Path`, `C:\`
*   **Status Bar:** `Scan Completed, Files Found: 1139234 (146.93 GB)`, `Recover All ...`

**3) COLOR (Estimated Hex)**
*   **Backgrounds:**
    *   App Background: `#F5F8FA` (Light Blue-Grey)
    *   Title Bar: `#EAF3FA`
    *   Tree/List Item Selected: `#D6EBFF` (Light Blue)
    *   Tree/List Item Hover (implied): `#EEF5FB`
    *   Preview Pane Card: `#FFFFFF`
    *   Status Bar Banner: `#FFFFFF`
*   **Surfaces & Text:**
    *   Primary Text: `#333333` or `#1A1A1A`
    *   Secondary Text (Dates/Sizes): `#666666`
    *   Link/Accent Text (AI Recommend): `#0078D4` (Windows Blue)
    *   Tab Active Text: `#0078D4`
    *   Tab Inactive Text: `#666666`
*   **Accents & Borders:**
    *   Primary Button (Recover All): `#2B85FF` (Gradient to lighter blue)
    *   Primary Button Text: `#FFFFFF`
    *   Secondary Button (Open): `#D6EBFF` (Background), `#0078D4` (Text)
    *   Buy Now Badge: `#FFB84D` (Orange/Yellow)
    *   Borders (Inputs/Panes): `#E0E0E0` or `#Dcdcdc`
    *   Divider Lines: `#EAEAEA`

**4) TYPOGRAPHY (Estimates)**
*   **Title Bar:** Segoe UI, ~9pt, Regular.
*   **Headings/Tabs:** Segoe UI Semibold, ~12px.
*   **List Items (Name):** Segoe UI, ~13px, Regular.
*   **Metadata (Date/Size):** Segoe UI, ~12px, Regular, Grey.
*   **Status Message:** Segoe UI Semibold, ~14px.

**5) SPACING & SIZING**
*   **Row Height (List):** ~42px per item.
*   **Row Height (Tree):** ~36px per item.
*   **Icon Size (Folder/File):** 24x24px or 32x32px (looks like standard 32px large icons).
*   **Checkbox Size:** 16x16px or 18x18px.
*   **Padding (List Items):** Left: ~12px, Vertical: ~8px.
*   **Control Heights:**
    *   Search Box / Dropdowns: ~32px.
    *   Buttons (Filter/Open): ~32px.
    *   Primary CTA (Recover All): ~44px.
*   **Gutters:** ~10-12px between columns in the list view. ~16px padding inside the Preview pane card.
*   **Radii:**
    *   Buttons: ~4px or ~6px (Slight rounding).
    *   Search/Input fields: ~4px.
    *   Preview Card: ~8px.
*   **Stroke Widths:** 1px for borders/dividers.

**6) CONTROLS & STATES**
*   **Navigation:** Home (Icon), Back (Disabled/Greyed out), Forward (Disabled), Up (Disabled).
*   **View Toggles:** List View (Selected/Active).
*   **Search:** Input field (Normal state, placeholder text visible).
*   **Dropdowns:** "Show", "File Type", etc. (Normal/Closed).
*   **Toggle Switch:** "AI Recommend" (Off/Left position, grey track).
*   **Tabs:** "Path" (Active, white background, top border), "Type" (Inactive, transparent background).
*   **Tree View:**
    *   Expand/Collapse arrows (Chevron right for collapsed).
    *   Checkboxes (Unchecked square).
    *   Selection: "Windows (C:)" row has light blue background indicating focus or selection context, though no checkbox is checked.
*   **List View:**
    *   Checkboxes (Unchecked).
    *   Sort Indicator: Up arrow on "Name" column header.
    *   Selection: First row ("actionarchivecache") is highlighted (Selected State).
*   **Buttons:**
    *   "Open" (Secondary/Outline style, Normal).
    *   "Recover All ..." (Primary/Filled style, Normal).
    *   "Buy Now" (Badge style).

**7) ICONOGRAPHY**
*   **Style:** Flat, Outline (for toolbar/nav) and Filled (for file types/folders).
*   **Weights:** 1.5px - 2px stroke for outline icons.
*   **Specifics:**
    *   Folders: Standard Windows-style yellow/blue folder icons (Filled).
    *   Toolbar: Line icons (Home, Arrows, Filter, Menu lines).
    *   Status: Large Checkmark in circle (Green/Blue gradient).

**8) STATE**
*   **Page State:** **Success / Data Populated**. The scan is finished ("Scan Completed"), and results are displayed.
*   **Context:** The user is browsing the "Windows (C:)" drive results. The first folder is selected, triggering the preview pane update.
*   **Motion Cues:** None visible (static screenshot). The scrollbar in the list view indicates there is more content below.
